# Daily tasks

Every day has three tasks: an easy, a medium and a hard one. Days change at **00:00 UTC**. Everyone on the same band gets the same three, and the targets and the pay fit your build. Finish a task in a run and it is paid when that run ends, or straight away if you [save and quit](basics.md#save-and-quit) or leave the game. A forge card levelled up by a merge in the Forge is paid at once.

- A run counts toward the tasks of the day it started, even if it goes past midnight.
- A run you save and then continue on a later UTC day than the one it started on no longer counts toward any task.
- Challenge runs never count, except toward a task to earn a challenge medal. A Daily Run counts like any run.
- "One run" tasks take your best single run of the day. "The whole day" tasks add up across every run that day.
- New players do the 6 [Getting started](basics.md#getting-started) goals first. Daily tasks start once the last one is claimed.

## Bands

Your band is set by your build the first time you play each day, and holds for the rest of that day.

| Band | Who | Pay |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fresh | Less than 1,000 meta spent on the tree | x0.5 |
| Growing | 1,000 meta or more spent on the tree | x1 |
| Full Tree | Every level of the base tree owned | x2 |
| Ascended | Ascended at least once | x3 |

## Pay and the streak

Finish any task on back to back days to build a streak. Miss a day and the streak starts again from day 1. Each day has a base pay by streak day, times your band: easy pays the base, medium 1.5x and hard 2x. Finishing all three in one day adds 50% of the three on top. Every 7th day of a streak also opens a free **Astral Crate**, or pays its 850 meta price where crates are not on sale. Ascending raises all of it by your ascension multiplier; Double Meta and Alchemist do not.

| 1 | 100 | 100 | 150 | 200 | 225 |

Reach a 7 day streak once to earn the **Keeper** dice, and it stays yours even if the streak breaks later.
